params.body:
## Why

The offer, order, test-drive and customer-mode modals were the last Bootstrap grid/form markup in the stocklist flow (`row`/`col-md-*`, `input-group`, `form-control`, `custom-switch`, `nav-tabs`, `btn btn-primary`). This moves them to the ui vocabulary the rest of the app already speaks (`ui-form-grid`, `ui-field`, `ui-affix`, `ui-switch`, `ui-button`) with identical behaviour: same fields, names, ids, `onclick=` handlers and JS hooks (`.relation_name`, `.help-block` as next sibling of the input's parent, `.flexlease_row`/`.flexlease_select`/`.flexlease_price`, `.rental-<field>` followed by its help-block, `#extras_table`/`#last_extra_row`/`#extras_empty`, `.close`, `data-toggle`/`data-dismiss`).

The `.modal / .modal-dialog / .modal-content / .modal-header` shell stays: there is no `x-ui.modal` component, and `modal.js` (`modal.get`, the `$.fn.modal` shim, the `data-toggle`/`data-dismiss` handlers, `.close`) selects on that shell. Only the body and footer markup was migrated.

## What per view

- `stocklist/_tabs/offertemodal.blade.php`: two-column `ui-form-grid` (relation with the picker button as an affix, price with the euro affix and the hints, language, takeover price, discount, advance), the warranty box as its own segmented control (`ui-warranty-tabs`/`ui-warranty-tab`/`ui-warranty-pane`, Alpine `x-show` instead of Bootstrap `tab-pane`), the extras box as `ui-extras-table`, FlexLease switches as `x-ui.switch` (hidden 0 written by hand so the POST stays byte-identical, including the disabled towbar case), the FlexLease request table as `ui-rows-table`, submit as `ui-button--primary`.
- `stocklist/_tabs/bestelbonModal.blade.php`: same vocabulary; the RealGarant switch keeps its hidden `1`; the quick-description textarea keeps its `.quick_description` toggle; `#spoticar_finance_options` keeps its `d-none` toggle.
- `stocklist/_tabs/rentalmodal.blade.php`: every field wrapper keeps its `rental-<name>` class with the help-block as next sibling, because `rental.js` writes the server error there with `.next()`.
- `stocklist/klantenmodusmodal.blade.php`, `stocklist/klantenmodus_margemodal.blade.php`: grid plus affix; the 64/36 split of the margin modal is now one grid rule.
- `offertes/flexleaseOfferRow.blade.php`: the row the offer modal includes; Bootstrap `spinner-grow` replaced by the `fa-spinner` the rest of the app uses.
- `resources/css/refresh.css`: the rules that only styled the replaced markup are gone (`#createOfferte #extras_table .input-group/.form-control`, `.ui-warranty-box .nav-tabs/.tab-content`, `#klantenmodusindexModal .form-control/.input-group-text/.btn-success/.row > .col-md-6`, the `.mt-3`/`.form-group` compaction rules); new: `ui-modal-grid`, `ui-affix-button`, `ui-warranty-tabs/-tab/-pane/-months`, `ui-extras-table`, `ui-flexlease`, `ui-rows-table/-action`, `ui-flexlease-result/-errors/-loading`, a switch-in-modal-body guard, and `.ui-modal-note` unscoped from `#createOfferte`.

Not touched: `resources/views/ownstock/**` (another PR) and its rules.

## Unused views found

Not migrated, candidates for removal (no route and no include reaches them):

- `resources/views/stocklist/_tabs/extendedSearch.blade.php`: no `@include` or `view()` anywhere; `stocklist` and `stocklist/results` both render `stocklist.livewire_preview` (the Livewire StocklistBrowser).
- `resources/views/stocklist/_tabs/filter.blade.php`: only included by `stocklist/index.blade.php`, which no route or controller renders any more.
- `resources/views/stocklist/index.blade.php`: same.

## Screenshots

Rendered through the test kernel (fixture admin, a FlexLease-eligible vehicle, RealGarant lines injected) and Playwright at 1280 and 390, before and after, in the session scratchpad as `tw-modals-{before,after}-{offer,offer-flexlease,order,rental,klantenmodus,klantenmodus-index}-{1280,390}.png`. The RealGarant switch in the order modal and the FlexLease price call hit the network, so those parts show their loading state in the harness.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` on every compiled view.
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Offer|Order|Pricing'`: green (the risky ones are the known error-handler notices).
- `npm run build` (public/build not committed).
- Pricing is not touched: the prefill expressions (`CustomerModePrice::forViewer(...)->documentPrefill/orderPrefill`) are the same lines.
params.title: Stocklist modals: Bootstrap grid/forms to the ui vocabulary
